name: PM25 Randall V6GL
description: PM25 estimates from the V6.GL.02.04 algorithm, representing the most state-of-the-science global algorithm for satellite-derived PM2.5 estimates. This version estimates annual and monthly ground-level fine particulate matter for 1998-2023 by combining Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) retrievals from multiple satellite-based NASA instruments with the GEOS-Chem chemical transport model, and subsequently calibrating to global ground-based observations using a residual Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). V6.GL.02.04 includes updated ground-based observations for the entire time series, extends temporal coverage through 2023, includes retrievals from the SNPP VIIRS instrument, and addresses previous limitations with abnormally low values using a modified padding strategy and stronger geophysical constraints.
